comments.author: Wystein
comments.body:
This can be plundered from an ambush fleet in the Gulf of Bothnia (North of Stockholm). The fleet is a Viking fleet and only ambushes players with high levels.

I don't know the exact specifics but it seems to be more than 150 total levels but less than 216. Pretty rare drop so highly recommended to have an aide with the aide plunder skill.

There are two different Viking ambush fleets that look identical. From one fleet you can plunder Master craftsman's carpentry tools & Thorstein the Red's armour (another memorial album item).

The other fleet drops the Great Viking crest and Loki's goblet.
